Um jeito de observar, registrar e cuidar: A way to observe, record and care for our waters, with everyone taking part.
O lixo nos rios, canais e na Baía de Gua: Waste in rivers, canals and Guanabara Bay harms the landscape, affects animals and makes these places harder to care for. People who live nearby or pass through often see the problem, but their observations remain scattered. AquaSentinel brings these records together, follows what happens at each location over time and helps communities, researchers and responsible teams plan care and cleanup activities.
O que queremos fazer?: What do we want to do?
O AquaSentinel reúne fotos, locais e dat: AquaSentinel brings together photos, locations and dates to help track visible waste in our waters. Images undergo AI analysis and team review before publication. Over time, this history can support community participation, research and action planning.
Você conhece um rio, canal ou trecho da: Do you know a river, canal or part of Guanabara Bay that needs attention? Your photo can help show what is happening there. Join AquaSentinel and turn your view of the city into an invitation to care for our waters.
Você tira uma foto, e a inteligência art: You take a photo, and artificial intelligence helps identify visible waste in the image. Your observation becomes a record that can be followed alongside others from the area. The team checks the results so that the information presented is clear and reliable.
Cuidar da água também é cuidar da vida!: Caring for water means caring for life!
O projeto segue a ideia de Saúde Única (: The project follows the One Health approach: the environment, animals and people are connected. Our records help observe environmental signs and encourage care for these places!
Observamos as águas, as margens e os res: We observe the water, banks and waste shown in the images.
Prestamos atenção à vegetação e aos anim: We pay attention to vegetation and animals that live in these places or move near the waste.
Incentivamos a participação, a educação: We encourage participation, environmental education and the safety of those submitting observations.
Para comunidades, educadores, estudantes: For communities, educators, students, researchers, environmental organizations and teams that want to follow places over time and record their actions.
Queremos que cada registro ajude a conta: We want each record to help tell the story of a place: where waste appears, which areas still need attention and what changes after a cleanup. Following this information over time makes it easier to decide where to act and observe the results.
Tire uma foto de um ponto seguro ou envi: Take a photo from a safe place or upload a JPG, PNG or WEBP up to 12 MB.
A inteligência artificial ajuda a identi: Artificial intelligence helps identify visible waste in your photo.
É só marcar o local no mapa, usando o GP: Mark the location on the map using GPS or by adjusting the point manually, check the address, and you are ready!
O nosso sistema confere as informações r: Our system checks the recorded information and compares your photo with previous submissions to avoid duplicates.
Confira os dados, autorize a publicação: Check the details, authorize publication and submit your record. Done! You have just helped care for our waters.
Depois de verificados e autorizados, os: Once verified and authorized, records appear on the map. Explore where waste has been observed and which areas still need more observations.
Consulte dias observados, níveis anterio: See observation days, previous levels, photos and the location page.
Quando os registros mostram lixo repetid: When records repeatedly show waste in the same area, AquaSentinel may highlight it as a place needing attention. This indication considers when and how often observations were made.
Depois de uma ação de limpeza, a equipe: After a cleanup, the team can record what was done and follow new photos of the location. Everyone can then see the before and after and observe how the area changes over time.
